profile.name: 数据采集模块
profile.description: 这是一个非物理的软件模块，用于 Zurich Instruments 的 LabOne 环境中，从多个仪器信号源按设定数据率采集、对齐并读取时域或频域数据。它支持连续采集、基于触发条件的突发采集，以及手动触发与采集结果读取，常用于实验测量过程中的数据记录与分析。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software module used in the Zurich Instruments LabOne environment to acquire, align, and read time-domain or frequency-domain data from multiple instrument signal sources at a defined data rate. It supports continuous acquisition, trigger-based burst acquisition, manual triggering, and readout of acquired data for laboratory measurement and analysis workflows.

registry.name: Zurich Instruments ziDAQ
registry.description: Zurich Instruments ziDAQ Module 仪器 数据采集模块是由Zurich Instruments生产的表征设备，主要功能包括触发、读取数据。
